new_sources.title: Super-Logarithmic Lower Bounds for Dynamic Graph Problems
new_sources.publication_note: SIAM J. Comput. article available online 2025-02-13; Volume 55(3) journal issue June 2026; earlier FOCS 2023 conference version is not a second independent work.
new_sources.relevant_bound: ~Omega(log^(3/2) n) max(update/query) cell-probe cost for dynamic DAG reachability with edge insertions
new_sources.limits: Does not concern immutable XOR DAG under source-bit FLIP, cryptographic proof lengths, or unrestricted server CPU. Cannot multiply with IVC certificate size absent a same-model reduction.

new_sources.title: Verifiable Streaming Computation and Step-by-Step Zero-Knowledge
new_sources.publication_note: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive states Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue asserted.
new_sources.relevant_bound: IVsC framework supports incremental verifiable streaming RAM computations and step-by-step ZK under cryptographic assumptions
new_sources.limits: Construction not an unconditional lower bound; does not imply malicious fork/rollback freshness against multiple independently stateful clients.
